1999.o: Bhoomi Pujan of Garden, Yogi Jayanti
w: The Government of Maharashtra has sanctioned 135 acres of land for the Sanstha at Vashi in New Mumbai. At 10.40 a.m., the Bhoomi Pujan ceremony was performed by Swamishri for the Garden (Akshardham Complex) and saplings of coconut trees were planted. At 11.00 a.m., the deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Shri Gopinath Munde, was welcomed and he unveiled the plaque for the Akshardham Garden Complex. The Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Shri Narayan Rane, had also arrived for the occasion. He lauded the social and religious activities of the Sanstha and was, having seen the Akshardham Complex in Gandhinagar and the Swaminarayan Mandir in London, convinced that the new Akshardham Complex at Vashi would be the pride of Maharashtra and the world. In the evening the festival of Yogi Jayanti was celebrated with enthusiasm and devotion.

At 10.15 am Swamishri attended a special assembly of intelligent students and their parents. Speeches on 'Intelligence and Character', 'Information on Computer Training' and 'Importance of Good Study' were given. Swamishri honored and gave prizes to ten top students. The assembly concluded with Swamishri's blessings.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev and Guru parampara. In the evening, Swamishri departed from Amalsad and arrived in Vyara at 7.30 p.m.

ds.t: The unique gardener of the Gunatit garden!
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj is the unique gardener of the Gunatit garden. Tending the garden of satsang so that it remains ever fresh, blossoming and fragrant has become an inseparable part of his life.

Today an old satsangi from Nadiad had come for darshan. His family's satsang went back to his father and grandfather in the time of Shastriji Maharaj. Swamishri knows all three generations. Swamishri casually asked him, "Why don't I see your son?"
He said, "Bapa! I come, but he has now lost interest in satsang." Saying this, he also presented some other complaints about him before Swamishri.

Swamishri said to Prabuddhamuni Swami, standing beside him, "Take his address. Phone him three or four times. Explain to him, 'Swami has instructed you. You have to keep up satsang. Come and meet. Your father is a satsangi, you too are a satsangi, your grandfather is also a satsangi, so why have you fallen back?'"

Again Swamishri said, "Well, he is young, so bad company must have affected him. But phone him two, three, four times and call him." Even at this advanced age, how much faith Swamishri has in reawakening a seeker who has strayed from the path!

Under the auspices of the BAPS Centenary Celebration Year a grand procession (Bhakti Feri) was organized. More than 4,500 devotees from India, USA, England, South Africa, East Africa, Botswana, Zambia and other places had assembled to participate. At 10.15 am Swamishri flagged off the Bhakti Feri. Senior sadhus along with the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj showered petals upon the mandir and procession from a helicopter. The colourful devotional pageant included sadhus chanting dhun in front, followed by a marching band of BAPS youths playing the Swaminarayan dhun and local tunes like ‘Jambo, Jambo bana…‘, children waving BAPS flags, the BAPS Centenary float with the utsav murti of Bhagwan Swaminarayan, devotees carrying flags of different countries, and finally women dressed in traditional dress carrying auspicious kalashes on their heads. The 2.5 km long Bhakti Feri, awash with colours, devotional singing and dancing, proclaimed the message and spirit of the BAPS Centenary Year Celebrations. At 6.50 pm Swamishri arrived in the assembly hall. Extracts from the mega-drama, ‘Yagnapurush Sukhakari’, were enacted, namely, Shastriji Maharaj’s departure from Vartal, the difficulties faced by his sadhus (‘Gaamo gaame ghume…’) and lively traditional dances on the lyric ‘Haiyamaa anand ati ubhraay…’ The entire hall was packed with devotees and well wishers. Swamishri blessed and honoured MP and former Environment Minister of India Shri Suresh Prabhu with a garland. Finally, in his blessings, Swamishri said, “It was Shastriji Maharaj’s principle to sing the glory of Maharaj, teach the philosophy of Akshar and Purushottam, and please Maharaj. He himself was unique and divine, and by God’s grace he had a following of faithful devotees.” Then Swamishri explained the philosophy of Akshar and Purushottam as propagated by Bhagwan Swaminarayan with scriptural references and historical examples.

Branch managers of the Bank of Baroda had come for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Mr Kabra, manager of the Kisumu branch, said, "What power do you have that when a single word comes from your mouth, everyone is ready to sacrifice everything?" Swamishri said, "The one who does the work is God. Everything happens only by His grace, and everything happens by the grace of the guru. In whatever we do, the doer is God alone. Without His inspiration nothing can happen. That is the secret."

Mr Kabra said, "Now what other special work do you wish to do?" Swamishri said, "We do whatever work God inspires. Because it is only through Him that works happen. In whatever work happens, it is God's plan alone."

While Pramukh Swami Maharaj is taking his walk, the thal sung every day in Thakorji's room outside can be heard. Today the khichdi thal was being sung. Laughingly, Swamishri said, "Thakorji eats khichdi every day."
I said, "Thakorji accepts many dishes along with the khichdi, but you eat just khichdi every day."
Hearing this, Swamishri burst out laughing.

I said, "Thakorji accepts many dishes along with the khichdi, but it is you who eat a thal of only khichdi every day."
Hearing this, Swamishri burst out laughing.
